acceptanceObjective: Introduce a minimal embodied pose-state (restore records for certified-skill parameter writes) and a single auditable SafeRecovery choke point in the renderer, so cancellation, renderer disable, application quit and test-exit all pass through one recovery sequence that restores pose values, releases input leases and admission, and resumes L2 movement. Full-skeleton PoseState remains future work.
notes: Recovery must be idempotent and must not change behavior outside .test_mode; existing drives keep passing with recovery logs visible.
